title: Reduce Home live run noise
summary: Reworked the Home live-run strip into a compact run monitor with one primary current-step summary, five compact facts, and a collapsed evidence-details disclosure.
reason: The previous Home live-run panel exposed every backend live-run fact as equally prominent cards, creating excessive noise during active CSV reruns and media processing.
behavior_before: Home rendered the live-run strip as a full grid of backend facts, including CSV rows, import lines, route, queue, ETA, update age, FFmpeg, worker, reliability, and close-readiness at the same visual level.
behavior_after: Home renders the live run as an operator monitor: current status/stage is primary, key facts stay visible, and the full evidence list remains available in a disclosure. Other live-run strips keep their existing evidence-rich rendering.
manual_validation: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/progressView.js -> passed with 0 errors and 6 existing warnings
rollback_plan: Revert apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/progressView.js, apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/styles/components/progress-live.css, and their regenerated summaries for this packet.
notes:
Add compact Home live-run monitor layout, responsive containment, and disclosure styling.
Refresh generated summary after Home live-run renderer update.
Refresh generated summary after compact live-run monitor styles.
Render Home live run as a compact monitor while keeping backend evidence available.
